P0_STYLE_FINDING.what: the Stage-4B TEMP rig's WRIST_R head sits ON the forearm cut plane: its z (0.277349 m) equals the mesh bounding-box minimum (0.276016 m), and the Stage-4B run log itself reports 'narrowest cross-section at -1.9 mm from the forearm cap'
P0_STYLE_FINDING.why_it_matters: CON-6 says to prefer reusing the Stage-4B WRIST_R joint centre AND forbids using the forearm cut-plane centre.  Those two clauses conflict, because on this asset they are the same point.  The hard prohibition was treated as controlling.
P0_STYLE_FINDING.consequence: the two differ by ~58 mm along the arm
P0_STYLE_FINDING.secondary: the Stage-3 wrist_narrowest_z = 0.343 m was itself derived from a slice with only n = 8 vertices (neighbours n = 19..27); the level it names is nevertheless confirmed here by an independent robust locator
P0_STYLE_FINDING.requires: Human Review acknowledgement -- the Stage-4B skeleton's WRIST_R (and hence its 201 mm wrist->palm bone) is anatomically wrong.  It does not affect the RSSF joint-angle validation, which is measured entirely on the fingers.
